title: worktree_merged event payload
$comment: Class: OPTIONAL_SPEC_ID. spec_id present when the worktree was bound at merge time (typical).

auto_closed_spec.description: True when merge auto-flipped the bound spec to closed.

spec_already_closed.description: True when the merge found the bound spec already in lifecycle_state: closed and skipped closeSpec (the close was performed by an earlier `caws specs close`). Implies the merge appended no second spec_closed event. Optional; absent is equivalent to false.

lane_tip.description: Tip of the worktree lane at merge time (the second parent of merge_commit). Optional; absent on events written before CAWS-PREPUSH-PROVENANCE-REWORK-001. Prepush uses merge_commit..lane_tip as the governed lane range when present.

base_before.description: Base branch tip before the merge advanced it (the first parent of merge_commit). Optional; absent on events written before CAWS-PREPUSH-PROVENANCE-REWORK-001.

canonical_checkout_state.description: Whether the canonical checkout's index and working tree were safely advanced after the base ref moved. Optional for events written before CAWS-DEFECT-MERGE-STALE-CANONICAL-INDEX-001.

canonical_checkout_sync_error.description: Git's refusal when the safe canonical checkout refresh could not be applied. Present only when canonical_checkout_state is stale.

canonical_checkout_repair_command.description: The exact two-tree read-tree command that retries the refused canonical checkout transition after local changes are preserved.
